title: eyeread.in pack entry
description: One reviewed version of a pack: where its source and zip live, and the pack hash OmniShip signs. Stored at packs/<id>/<version>/entry.json.

repo.description: The pack's public git repository, as an https:// URL that `git clone` accepts.

tag.description: The release tag for this version, for example v1.2.0.

commit.description: The full commit SHA the tag points to.

path.description: The pack folder inside the repo: "." for the repo root, or a relative path such as "packs/notion-sync".

url.description: Where the app downloads the zip. https://, public, and never changes.

mirrors.description: Other URLs serving the same zip. Any one serving the right pack hash keeps the pack reachable.

packHash.description: The pack hash `eyeread.in-packs build` prints: SHA-256 of the canonical files.json.

withdrawn.description: Set by a maintainer when this version is withdrawn. The daily check skips it.
